title: Honeycomb Ingest key (hcXik_, hcXic_): one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 57-byte body vs exactly 58 and length: a 59-byte body vs exactly 58. Twin of "Honeycomb Ingest key (hcXik_, hcXic_): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of honeycomb-api-key-dotenv: length: a 57-byte body vs exactly 58. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
